runtime_strategy: All third-party runtime assets are vendored locally under assets/vendor and assets/fonts; zero CDN, zero network at runtime.

dependencies.name: gsap
dependencies.license: GreenSock Standard License (free for general use; review Webflow/bonus-plugin terms before commercial bundling of members-only plugins)
dependencies.usage: tween engine only; no GSAP theme/visual imported

dependencies.name: lenis
dependencies.usage: inertial smooth scroll; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

webgl_note: Lumen Core orb uses zero-dependency raw WebGL1 + original GLSL; the simplex noise function is the public-domain Ashima implementation used only as a noise primitive; lighting/color/state composition is original.
